hero.headline: Grass-fed beef from Paraguay, at conventional prices.
hero.allianceNote: Paraguay has raised cattle on grass for over 400 years. We trade its beef today, and we’re aligning a 300,000-head producer alliance behind it.

whatWeSellToday.body: Grass-fed Paraguayan beef under the MPCS standard, bought on the market and sold at conventional prices.
whatWeSellToday.noFullHistoryNote: What we can’t offer yet: a full ear-tag-to-box history. We’re building that first.

promise.body: We don’t need a higher price to make this work. We compete on resilience and scale, and a better product is how we mean to change what conventional beef looks like.

firstPick.body: Trade with us now, and you’re first in line when traceable supply from our own herds comes online.

whySupplyDifferent.body: Our own herds and the alliance herds are raised under one Code. That’s supply we control and can vouch for, not just source and hope.

whoVerifies.codeReferenceNote: Every animal is raised, and every herd sold, under the Orbolo Code.

crossLinkToInvest.label: Own the herd behind this beef
